comment: Trainable opening courses. Drop a course JSON (laionchess.course.v1 OR a Create-exported laionchess.folded-opening.v1) into this folder and add an entry here to publish it as a lesson on the Openings board.

courses.name: Scotch Game
courses.desc: A direct weapon against 1...e5. Open the center on move 3 and develop with tempo.

courses.name: Italian Game
courses.desc: Aim the bishop at f7 and build slowly with c3 and d3 in the Giuoco Pianissimo, with answers to the Two Knights, Hungarian and Paris defenses.

courses.name: Ruy Lopez
courses.desc: The Spanish Game: steady pressure on e5, with the Closed main line, the Open Spanish, the Anti-Berlin and sound answers to every sideline.

courses.name: Queen's Gambit
courses.desc: The classical 1.d4 d5 2.c4, covering the QGD, QGA and Slav, plus ways to punish the Albin, Chigorin and Baltic.

courses.name: London System
courses.desc: A reliable Bf4, e3 and c3 setup against almost everything, with clear plans against ...c5, ...Qb6, the King's Indian and the Dutch.

courses.name: Sicilian Najdorf
courses.desc: The most combative answer to 1.e4: a flexible ...a6 system with queenside and central counterplay.

courses.name: Caro-Kann Defense
courses.desc: A rock-solid reply to 1.e4 with a sound pawn structure and an active light-squared bishop.

courses.name: French Defense
courses.desc: Lock the center against 1.e4, then undermine White's pawn chain with ...c5 and ...Qb6.

courses.name: Scandinavian Defense
courses.desc: Challenge 1.e4 at once with 1...d5 and ...Qa5: a clear, solid system with quick development.

courses.name: King's Indian Defense
courses.desc: Let White build a big center against 1.d4, then strike back with ...e5 or ...c5 and attack the king.

courses.name: Catalan Opening
courses.desc: Fianchetto on g2 against ...e6 and ...d5: the Open Catalan with Qc2/Qa4, the Closed Catalan, plus Benoni and King's Indian set-ups.

courses.name: English Opening
courses.desc: 1.c4 with a g3 fianchetto against 1...e5 and 1...c5, the Mikenas Attack against ...e6 and an e4 center against ...g6.

courses.name: Vienna Game
courses.desc: Hit 1...e5 with 2.Nc3 and f4: the Vienna Gambit against 2...Nf6, Bc4 lines against 2...Nc6 and a plan against 2...Bc5.

courses.name: Grünfeld Defense
courses.desc: Hit White's center with ...d5, ...Bg7 and ...c5: Exchange (Rb1, Bc4, Be3), Russian System, 4.Bf4, 4.Bg5 and anti-Grünfelds.

courses.name: Nimzo-Indian Defense
courses.desc: Pin with 3...Bb4 against 3.Nc3 (Rubinstein, Classical, Sämisch, Leningrad…), the Queen's Indian against 3.Nf3 and ...dxc4 against the Catalan.

courses.name: Slav Defense
courses.desc: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 c6: the Main Line with ...dxc4 and ...Bf5, the Exchange Slav, 4.e3, Chebanenko ideas and the Winawer Countergambit.

courses.name: Accelerated Dragon
courses.desc: 1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 g6: Maróczy Bind, 5.Nc3 with Bc4, the ...d5 break, the Rossolimo and the Alapin.

courses.name: Petroff Defense
courses.desc: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6: the Classical 5.d4, 5.Nc3, 3.d4, the Four Knights, the Vienna and the Bishop's Opening.
